newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market turnover down to 25.4 bln lei.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market turnover down to 25.4 bln lei.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market turnover fell to 25.4 billion lei in five days of trading this week against more than 30 billion last week.
Over 8.9 million shares changed hands on the RASDAQ -- the Romanian OTC system modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ -- up from 6.6 million the previous week.
"Romcim remain investors' main target", one trader said.
Cement maker Romcim SA, which took more than 70 percent of the week's turnover, recently announced plans to move on to the Bucharest stock exchange encouraged by its strong OTC performance.
Romcim closed at 34,000 lei on Friday, gaining 300 lei on the week.
The independent VAB-RASDAQ index, computed by Vanguard SA securities, fell some 24 points on the week to 1,609.6.
The RASDAQ, which opened last October to eventually trade 5,000 companies privatised under a mass selloff, now lists 2,667 stocks. It traded an average 300 companies this week. ($=7,744 lei)
